text:
mira: quick heads-up 1: were running a short pricing/packaging experiment next week. scope: FAQ refresh to surface Dedicated vs Private, two naming variants for tiers, and a compact committed-capacity calculator. metrics: pricing CTA rate, webinar opt-ins, and high-value lead count.

jess: Sounds good. For FAQ variants I can do a concise line + one expanded version. Example concise: "Dedicated: predictable throughput and flat unit economics for production apps." longer: 2-3 bullets.

sam: Analytics check: will add events `pricing_variant`, `calculator_started`, `committed_amount_usd`, `webinar_opt_in`. GTM naming convention: pricing.experiment.variant, pricing.calculator.opened, pricing.calc.commit_amount.

carol: Routing: calculator -> if commit >= 5000 then tag 'high_commit' and route to AE queue; else tag 'interest' and route to SDR. will update Intercom playbook and set up nightly CSV export for high_commit leads.

tony: micro-calculator UX: can we keep it to 3 fields: monthly token volume, concurrency tier, committed discount slider. result = est monthly cost + recommended dedicated config. also add a one-question qualifier after submit: "What are you building?" short text.

mira: timeline: copy drafts Tue, dev integration Wed, QA Thu, soft launch Mon. any blockers?

jess: legal flag: avoid words that imply guaranteed contracts. ill run tier names by legal before lock. also will put two naming sets in Notion: https://notion.so/rw/pricing-experiment-draft

sam: deploy-bot: adding deploy window Thu 18:00 UTC to push staging. note: ensure feature flag pricing_experiment_v1.

in deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/pricing-experiment_v1 -> Thu 18:00 UTC by @sam :white_check_mark:

carol: one more: add `webinar_source=pricing_page` to the signup event so we can tie webinar attendees back to the page variant.

mira: agree. also plan a launch post + benchmark narrative for the webinar mailer: short headline about predictable inference economics, 2 bullets on Dedicated/Dedicated benefits, link to calculator. Jess pls draft.

jess: will draft hero copy + two subject lines for webinar invite. sharing by EOD.

sam: I'll instrument Amplitude cohort and funnel for the flows. Markers: saw_pricing_page -> opened_calc -> submitted_calc -> opted_in_webinar.

mira: perfect. we want to keep test live for 2 weeks then review conversion and lead quality. thanks all :tada:
